verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a recruiting SaaS that holds candidate data, so the axis applies. The pack documents no retention policies, deletion endpoints, or GDPR-style erasure controls. The generic API claim of 'full control over your data' is not about retention or deletion specifically, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
